answers.rationale: The effective_rate relation establishes job J1 at 240 currency units per hour (TOW service code per service conditions).

No relation in the harbor_towing world establishes a fuel surcharge for any job; job_charge for J3 is computed solely as 2h at 120/hr with no fuel component.

Billing outcome for J7 is insufficient_evidence because B12 commercial towing after 18:00 lacks emergency documentation, and purpose_requirement_failure records no emergency log attached for J7 at berth B12.
